newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly up in higher trade driven by trade in BTEI bank, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 602.95 from 601.96 on Monday.
Trade volume was 5.8 million dinars against 2.06 million dinars.
The market was marked by the exchange of a bloc of 35,250 BTEI bank shares worth 736,725 dinars at 20.9 dinars per share from a 20.6 dinar opening price.
Airliner TUNISAIR won 1.21 dinar to 19.4 dinars. BDET bank was up 0.43 dinar to 14.87 dinars. Banque de Tunisie was down 1.5 dinar to 76.5 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
